theorem quadratic_interval_characterization (a b x : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) : ((x - a) * (x - b) ≤ 0) ↔ x ∈ Set.Icc a b := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    
    have hxa : a ≤ x := by
      by_contra hxlt
      have hxlt' : x < a := lt_of_not_ge hxlt
      have hpos : (x - a) * (x - b) > 0 := by
        have h1 : 0 < a - x := sub_pos.mpr hxlt'

        have hpos' : (a - x) * (b - x) > 0 := mul_pos h1 h2
        have h_eq : (x - a) * (x - b) = (a - x) * (b - x) := by ring
        simpa [h_eq] using hpos'
      exact (not_le.mpr hpos) h
    
    have hxb : x ≤ b := by
      by_contra hxgt
      have hxgt' : b < x := lt_of_not_ge hxgt
      have hpos : (x - a) * (x - b) > 0 := by
        have h1 : 0 < x - a := sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_le_of_lt hab hxgt')
        have h2 : 0 < x - b := sub_pos.mpr hxgt'
        exact mul_pos h1 h2
      exact (not_le.mpr hpos) h
    exact ⟨hxa, hxb⟩
  · rintro ⟨hax, hxb⟩
    have h1 : 0 ≤ x - a := sub_nonneg.mpr hax
    have h2 : x - b ≤ 0 := sub_nonpos.mpr hxb
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos h1 h2

theorem quadratic_interval_characterization (a b x : ℝ) (hab : a ≤ b) : ((x - a) * (x - b) ≤ 0) ↔ x ∈ Set.Icc a b := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hxa : a ≤ x := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hlt : x < a := lt_of_not_ge hnot
      have hxb : x < b := lt_of_lt_of_le hlt hab
      have hp : 0 < (x - a) * (x - b) :=
        mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr hlt) (sub_neg.mpr hxb)
      linarith
    have hxb : x ≤ b := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hgt : b < x := lt_of_not_ge hnot
      have hax : a < x := lt_of_le_of_lt hab hgt
      have hp : 0 < (x - a) * (x - b) :=
        mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hax) (sub_pos.mpr hgt)
      linarith
    exact ⟨hxa, hxb⟩
  · rintro ⟨hxa, hxb⟩
    exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (sub_nonneg.mpr hxa) (sub_nonpos.mpr hxb)
